title: SourceId::validate callers outside observations may report a complete identity as invalid on a cancelled capture
outcome: Each caller that runs EngramSourceId::validate is known not to run on a cancelled capture worker, or validates the in-memory identity without depending on the capture's cancellation, so a complete identity is never reported as invalid because of host shutdown.
acceptance: The call sites src/acceptance_source.rs:189 (acceptance_source_bytes), src/native_test_completion.rs:103 and src/test_runs_disk.rs:19 are each classified, with evidence, as either never on a capture worker or able to run on one.

Any call site that can run on a capture worker and only reads memory validates outside the capture's cancellation, with the existing shape rules and budget unchanged, and a discriminating test shows a complete identity stays valid after the capture is stopped.
